## 11500 - 11599

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11500 TKT - High Close observed temperature</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11500">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users that the imported, manually entered, or calculated value is above the user-defined limit for maximum close observed temperature. The ticket types associated with this exception are: Gauge, Run, and Vessel Tank.

</div>
